A RUN BEFORE WORK

Parks near Triver

Three options for a morning run. Distances are approximate one-way approaches from Florencia 39, not measured running routes.

Bosque de Chapultepec

(large wooded city park)

About 1.5–2 km to the eastern side. Our pick for a longer run among the trees. The jog there can be your warm-up; check access hours for your chosen entrance.

Route to the eastern entrance ↗

Parque España

(small leafy neighborhood park)

About 1.5 km away. A short outing with repeated laps, or a warm-up stop on the way to Condesa.

Walking route from Triver ↗

Parque México & Avenida Amsterdam

(park paths and a tree-lined central walkway)

About 2 km away. Our pick for a relaxed neighborhood run followed by coffee. Amsterdam’s loop has street crossings, so expect a few pauses.

Walking route from Triver ↗

Choose a route to suit the morning. These are regular running options, so there’s nothing to tick off.

BEFORE WE GO

Just a little planning

Frida comes first. Book a timed ticket online; there are no ticket sales at the door. Official tickets ↗

Dinner at Máximo. Already booked. Pick the rest of that evening around it.

Keep Mondays light. Anthropology, Chapultepec Castle, the Museo de Arte Moderno and Bellas Artes close on Mondays. Check official opening times before setting out.

Puebla, Tolantongo and Xilitla are for another trip. Nothing here needs to become a race.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Red Nacional de Refugios to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
